CSCO.reason: Customer inventory digestion and cautious IT spending reduced product demand and drove a fiscal-2024 revenue decline.

TEL.reason: Industrial-equipment demand fell during supply-chain inventory corrections, offsetting strength in TE's other end markets.

BKNG.reason: No material operating setback was verified; the business posted record room nights, but the fixed +30% one-year hurdle was too aggressive.

ORLY.reason: Comparable-sales growth slowed sharply as DIY transactions weakened, leaving solid earnings growth short of the +30% stock-price hurdle.

VZ.reason: A saturated wireless market, moderating connection growth and aggressive promotions limited the re-rating of Verizon's mature, debt-heavy business.

LOW.reason: High rates and weak housing turnover depressed big-ticket DIY demand; fiscal-2024 comparable sales fell 2.7% on fewer transactions.

CMG.reason: Consumer pullback and lower traffic pushed comparable sales negative and reduced guidance, compressing Chipotle's premium growth valuation.

KLAC.reason: Tighter U.S. semiconductor-export controls reduced KLA's China exposure and created uncertainty around a major revenue market.

HPE.reason: The DOJ lawsuit delayed the Juniper acquisition and the eventual settlement required divestitures, prolonging deal and integration uncertainty.

TCOM.reason: No material operating setback was verified and travel demand stayed strong; the shares simply did not clear the fixed +30% hurdle on time.

ZM.reason: Post-pandemic normalization left Zoom near 3% annual revenue growth while intense communications-software competition constrained its re-rating.

TKO.reason: A $375 million UFC antitrust settlement and continuing litigation created a material legal overhang despite strong underlying media assets.

DIS.reason: Continued cord-cutting reduced domestic linear-network subscribers and affiliate revenue, offsetting improvement in streaming and parks.

T.reason: Persistent legacy Business Wireline declines and the mature telecom growth profile kept AT&T below the fixed +30% one-year hurdle.
